heading: Saunas, Spas & Warm Soaks for Cold Days
title: Okanagan Saunas, Spas & Hot Tubs | Okanagan Roam
description: Floating lake saunas, a social bathhouse, a thermal spa circuit and pools with hot tubs and steam rooms for warming up on a cold Okanagan day.
intro: When the valley turns grey and cold, a bit of real heat goes a long way. Around the Okanagan you can sit in a cedar sauna on the lake, work through a hot-and-cold circuit, or take the kids for a swim and slip into the hot tub yourself.
Here's where to warm up, from saunas built for an evening with friends to the community pools with a hot tub and steam room. Each place shows its town.

items.name: Löyly Floating Sauna
items.text: a Finnish-style cedar sauna floating at Kelowna's Downtown Marina, with a lake cold plunge and a warm solarium lounge overlooking Okanagan Lake. Book a shared 80-minute community session or take over the whole sauna with friends.

items.name: Shelter Floating Sauna
items.text: a cedar sauna floating on Okanagan Lake at the Lakeside Resort marina, where you cycle between heat, a cold plunge in the lake and rest. Join a shared social session or book the whole sauna privately for up to eight people.

items.name: Tality Wellness Kelowna
items.text: a downtown social bathhouse with a 20-person cedar sauna, four cold plunges and a lounge around a vapour firepit, with robes, towels and kombucha included. Book a shared community session or a private group slot.

items.name: Cleopatra's Rituals Thermal Spa and Steam
items.text: a thermal spa with a hot-cold circuit of sauna, steam, thermal showers and a falling-snow room. Book a Thermal Ritual session solo, or reserve the space for a private group.

sections.heading: Pools with a hot tub, sauna or steam room

items.name: H2O Adventure + Fitness Centre
items.text: a YMCA-run indoor waterpark with waterslides, a FlowRider, wave pool, lazy river and splash park. A go-to for families on a cold or rainy day, with a hot tub and steam room for grown-ups.

items.name: Vernon Aquatic Centre
items.text: a warm leisure pool with a waterslide, rapids channel, rope swing, climbing wall and bubble pit, plus a sauna, steam room and hot tub.

items.name: Penticton Community Centre (Pool & Lazy River)
items.text: a leisure pool with a lazy river, spray features and a waterslide, and a big whirlpool, sauna and steam room for warming up on a cold day.

items.name: Johnson Bentley Memorial Aquatic Centre
items.text: an indoor pool with slides, a rope swing, a warm soaking pool, a hot tub and a steam room. Public swim sessions run daily.

items.name: Summerland Aquatic & Fitness Centre
items.text: an indoor pool and hot tub, celebrating 50 years in 2026, with evening and weekend public swims. Drop-in admission is inexpensive, and families get a combined rate.
